kind: Authored finite expectations; NOT executed lifecycle/runtime tests

cases.title: Purchase without an animal
cases.premise: A character has actual Animal Handling proficiency, does not own animal_companion, and has one source-qualified unspent feat opportunity. No animal is present.
cases.expected: Commit that opportunity once; record owned feat, no bond, and one unspent initial attempt. No animal, real-world receipt or rest is created.

cases.title: Failed or duplicate purchase
cases.premise: Missing proficiency or opportunity, or the feat is already owned.
cases.expected: Reject that purchase without a new grant, payment or allowance initialization. A proposed purchase canceled before commitment has no payment; cancellation after a valid purchase is not a refund.

cases.title: Valid start and first success
cases.premise: Previously paid grant; initial attempt 1; eligible real conditional animal with complete ordinary profile; actual uninterrupted touch-range work from t to t+3600 seconds.
cases.expected: At the single valid start spend 1→0 and record a pending attempt, with no companion profile yet. On lawful completion install one bond using latest actual body and owner values. No extra feat payment, RP or die roll.

cases.title: Four preserved HP endpoints
cases.premise: Owner total level4; corresponding genuine conditional SUP-02 bodies: Small ground5/10, Medium ground1/20, Tiny flyer3/7, Small swimmer7/10.
cases.expected: At successful bond maxHP9 and currentHP4,1,3,6 respectively. Conditions/injuries/breathing/identity persist. At owner level8 maxHP13, current values stay4,1,3,6 and spent attempt remains0. These are arithmetic fixtures, not authenticated animals.

cases.title: Rejected preflight versus prior paid grant
cases.premise: Feat already purchased. Proposed target has absent ordinaryHP, invalid type/INT/size/native mode, no real access/willing-or-tamed relation, or incompatible existing bond. No start occurred.
cases.expected: Reject start and leave its unspent attempt unchanged; preserve the previously paid feat. A missing record is not proof no earlier real start occurred.

cases.title: Interrupted first attempt
cases.premise: After a valid spent start, separately exercise contact/access loss, loss of both qualifying willing/tamed alternatives, disqualifying body change, owner incapacitation, voluntary abandonment or actual target death.
cases.expected: Terminate that attempt, retain spent allowance and elapsed time, preserve actual ordinary body losses/conditions/corpse as governed. No companion conversion. Resumed contact cannot complete the old partial hour.

cases.title: Same-epoch retry
cases.premise: T06 followed by another proposal before a new beneficial owner Long Rest; change scene, body, controller label or date label.
cases.expected: No new attempt. Feat ownership remains; no re-purchase, refund or late reconstruction of an unspent allowance.

cases.title: Genuine recharge
cases.premise: A new actually beneficial owner Long Rest completes under FS-06/EX58.
cases.expected: Set attempt allowance to1, never2. A new valid attempt needs all current gates and a new full hour; the earlier failure remains recorded. No animal heal, revival or automatic bond is granted.

cases.title: False recharge
cases.premise: Short Rest; debt-only eight-hour Rest; fewer than24 hours since previous beneficial LR; duplicate rest receipt; location/calendar reset; unsupported rest; or crediting active hour as rest.
cases.expected: No additional LR attempt recovery. Actual debt clearing remains where lawful; it is not a second beneficial resource refill.

cases.title: Replacement while bonded
cases.premise: Owner retains a current Animal Companion bond and has an unused refreshed attempt.
cases.expected: Reject the new bond start. No charge is spent by that rejected start and the old bond is not automatically released. No simultaneous provisional second companion or success-only exchange.

cases.title: Interrupted release
cases.premise: Owner begins the separate release hour; an interruption occurs before completion.
cases.expected: Old bond survives unless an independent event ended it. Actual time remains spent, no partial release progress is reusable; a fresh full release hour is allowed. No bond attempt/feat opportunity/RP is charged.

cases.title: Completed release and later rest gate
cases.premise: An owner with live companion and one unused attempt finishes a lawful release. For the numeric example companion current4/max9, saved ordinary maximum10.
cases.expected: Bond ends; restored ordinary current4/max10 under existing ratio conversion; conditions/custody remain. Prior unused attempt does not permit immediate replacement. Require a beneficial owner LR completion ordered after this end. Its start need not be after the end if the rest is genuinely lawful; active release work itself cannot count as rest.

cases.title: Death and no resurrection
cases.premise: Feat-chassis animal reaches0HP, or owner actually dies while the animal survives.
cases.expected: Retain the printed distinct outcomes: animal0HP is its one corpse/no death saves; owner death ends bond and restores a surviving animal by existing ratio. Death never creates another animal, new feat opportunity, attempt reset or permission to use a corpse.

cases.title: Failed replacement after release
cases.premise: Old bond validly ended, owner later completed beneficial LR, then began and interrupted replacement.
cases.expected: Feat remains owned; old bond stays ended; new attempt stays spent; neither old nor proposed animal becomes a companion. Another actual beneficial LR and full valid attempt are needed. Rebonding a released living individual uses the same gates and continuing identity, never a refreshed body.

cases.title: Receiving existing feat owner
cases.premise: Sender lawfully released living animal. Receiver already owns Animal Companion and is unbonded, with a legal attempt and own post-ending rest requirement satisfied, if applicable.
cases.expected: Receiver performs own full hour and spends own attempt, not another feat opportunity. Sender rest/ownership/cooldown never transfers. Receiver with an active bond or unmet own rest gate cannot begin.

cases.title: Receiving nonowner and class alternative
cases.premise: Receiver lacks Animal Companion; separately test actual opportunity/proficiency, neither feat nor class grant, and an actually selected eligible Ranger Warder Beast Companion.
cases.expected: Animal custody grants no feat. A legal first feat purchase initializes only that owner’s first allowance. Without either actual receiving grant there is no special bond. Ranger branch uses real Ranger16/Warder selection, CR≤Ranger level, willing/tamed noncorrupted Beast INT<7, real4RP, native once/LR and one-hour touch rules, not feat no-RP terms. No Ranger grant or timing exception is manufactured.

cases.title: No forced cross-engine termination
cases.premise: Proposed animal still belongs to an Animal Companion or Ranger bond; custody alone changed.
cases.expected: No receiving bond or stat addition. Outgoing source must genuinely end its bond first. Feat release does not author a Ranger-release procedure. Dead targets stay ineligible.

cases.title: Record and phase conservation
cases.premise: Valid transfer/rebond, latest injury during a successful hour, companion also proposed as a ridden mount, or attempted stale source reuse.
cases.expected: Use current actual HP/condition at completion; preserve underlying identity, ordinary profile, source restrictions, spent actor/body budgets and actual custody. Never import sender feat ownership/profile as receiver grant, clone a phase/controller/Reaction, reset an attack, heal to full or waive EX58 tack/load/mount gates.

cases.title: Invalid completion is not refund
cases.premise: An actual start already spent the allowance. A later submitted completion is short, interrupted, mismatched, missing or otherwise invalid.
cases.expected: Reject completion only. The recorded real purchase/start expenditure remains. No inferred refund, unspent state or retrospective valid hour. Source-supported record corrections retain predecessors, not a favorable fabricated past.

cases.title: Child ownership and preservation
cases.premise: Animal Companion was lawfully purchased without a current bond; later actual separate Warrior8 opportunity is available. Also inspect proposed edits.
cases.expected: Owned parent meets Companion Training’s printed OR node, subject to its other gates; no animal/use benefit is created. Preserve Animal Handling alternative, full Companion Training procedure, original objects, historical sourceDirection/submitted text, FS-01/06/10, all SUP-02 bodies, Ranger/EX58, unrelated feats and all existing approval/selection flags.
